title: Arguments from neuroscience should define consciousness

statements.text: When behavioral criteria for consciousness conflict, as in a split-brain patient who denies seeing what the left hand draws, neuroscience should override intuitive and introspective notions. Consciousness should be defined as recurrent processing, as the way to put its study on a scientific footing.

sources.quote: letting arguments from neuroscience override our intuitive and introspective notion
just that it is the only way to put the study of consciousness on a scientific footing
